tools.name: pinterest_run_catalog_report
tools.title: pinterest run catalog report
tools.description: Run Pinterest catalog reporting by PRODUCT_GROUP or PRODUCT_ITEM. Use PRODUCT_GROUP for older catalog delivery totals, not individual SKU performance.
